name: STM32_USB_Device_Library-CDC
description: USB Device middleware (Core + CDC class), vendored from STM32Cube FW_F1 via platformio/framework-stm32cubef1@1.8.6. Requires usbd_conf.h/usbd_desc.h/usbd_cdc_if.h from the project include/ directory (same pattern as FreeRTOSConfig.h for app/lib/FreeRTOS).
